name: Lightsaber pike
description: The lightsaber pike, also known as the Jedi Temple Guard lightsaber, was a lightsaber variant similar to the double-bladed lightsaber, featuring two rare yellow plasma blades on each side of the staff, and used by the Jedi Temple Guard.

data.name: Lightsaber pike
data.size: Longer hilt with much shorter blades than a double-bladed lightsaber
